title: NASA asteroid sheet: 4 Vesta diameter 569 x 555 x 453 km, ~mass 259,000×10^15 kg
summary: The sheet's selected-asteroid row for Vesta prints diameter 569 x 555 x 453 km and an approximate mass 259,000 × 10^15 kg.
body: The Asteroid Fact Sheet row for 4 Vesta prints diameter 569 x 555 x 453 km, mass about 259,000 × 10^15 kg, rotation period 5.342 hrs, orbital period 3.63 yrs, spectral class U, semi-major axis 2.362 AU, eccentricity 0.0889, and inclination 7.14 deg. Orbit values for epoch JD 2457400.5 (2016-01-13). Most of the values for mass and many of the diameter values are only rough estimates. The mass column header on the sheet is "~Mass", which marks the mass as approximate. The sheet's note says Vesta is the 3rd largest asteroid and was studied from orbit by the Dawn mission in 2011-2012. This card does not promote the row to a precision measurement.
